noRoots:
No library roots yet.
Folders you add appear here.
firstLaunchBody: Sift indexes folders on your disks and drives. It only reads and catalogues files, never moves, copies, or writes to them.
firstLaunchHint: Indexing runs in the background. You can browse and play while it works.
removeRootBody: This removes the folder from Sift's index only. Files on disk are not deleted.
missingBanner: The path is gone. Preview and drag-to-DAW are unavailable, but metadata stays until you remove the entry.
